title: Understanding K-Means Clustering
text: K-Means clustering is a popular method in unsupervised learning. One key aspect is that it requires you to decide on a specific number of clusters before you start the algorithm. Think about why this might be necessary and how it affects the clustering process.

title: Choosing the Number of Clusters
text: Why do you think it's important to specify the number of clusters in K-Means before running the algorithm?

title: Exploring the Impact of Cluster Number
text: Consider how the number of clusters you choose might influence the results of the K-Means algorithm. What happens if you choose too few or too many clusters?

title: Effects of Cluster Number on Results
text: What could be a potential consequence of choosing too many clusters in K-Means?
